Nina (CSM): Quick sync — OrbitPay QBR on Fri. Need 8 slides: onboarding status, adoption highlights, renewal risk, enablement asks, and runbook. Can we claim? Deck: https://redwood.app/decks/orbitpay-qbr

Rafael (AM): I'll take onboarding + adoption. Will pull 30/7 day funnels and onboarding completion rate. ETA Thu 2pm.

Bea - AE: I'll own renewal posture and exec asks. Renewal in ~50 days. Adding procurement timeline. ETA Thu 5pm.

Kai Eng: I'll add a short SRE runbook and latency guardrail snippet. Do we include the alert rule in notes?

Nina (CSM): Yes put the rule in notes and name file slides/08-runbook.pdf. Also add one-line exec ask per slide.

zebra-bot: Reminder: design review deadline Thu 6pm PT.

Rafael (AM): Uploading adoption slide to slides/03-adoption.png and adding sources. Noted a usage uptick after last integration.

Kai Eng: Paste guardrail snippet here:

```yaml
alert: OrbitPayLatencyP95
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{team="orbitpay"}[5m])) by (le)) > 0.14
for: 2m
annotations:
  summary: "OrbitPay p95 > 140ms"
```

Bea - AE: Added exec asks: 1) Approve 30-day Dedicated pilot; 2) Exec review post-pilot; 3) Procurement support. Tagged reviewers.

Nina (CSM): Final checklist before pre-read: slides named, sources linked, one-line asks, runbook attached. Dry run Thu 7pm PT.

zebra-bot: Dry run scheduled Thu 19:00 PT.
